name: Event Log Track Encrypt
description: Add support for encrypted logs to Events Log Track module (ELT).
project_description: Event Log Track Encrypt adds support for encrypted logs to the Events Log Track (ELT) module. It protects, without loss, sensitive data that may appear in ELT log entries (for example a configuration change whose description contains credentials). The module uses public-key cryptography: the log description is sealed with a public key (via PHP openssl_seal / AES256) before being written to the ELT log, and only the holder of the matching private key can decrypt it. Only the 'description' part of an ELT log entry is encrypted, wrapped in @@crypt@@ / @@endcrypt@@ tags. There is no graphical decryption interface; decryption is performed offline through the Drush commands the module provides (elt:decrypt-db, elt:decrypt-file, elt:decrypt-string), each requiring the private key file and its passphrase. It builds on the Encrypt and Key frameworks, shipping an Encrypt profile, a Key entity for the public key, an 'openssl_public_encrypt' EncryptionMethod plugin and a 'public_pem' KeyType plugin.
